Class ClientDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.ClientDispatch
@Internal public final class ClientDispatch extends Object
Dispatch of client-library calls: HTTP clients, JDBC and the messaging, RPC, cache and cloud clients.

One domain of the dispatch the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge; the evaluation it shares with the other domains is DispatchEngine. Not part of the stable API (see ChaosDispatcher).

  • Method Details

    • beforeClientCall

      public void beforeClientCall(String operation, Object client, @Nullable String target, @Nullable String detail, @Nullable Object remoteAddress) throws Throwable
      Called before a call through a client library (Kafka, gRPC, Redis, R2DBC, AWS SDK, Netty). A reject throws the library's own exception type (see FailureFactory.clientReject).
      Parameters:
      operation - the OperationType name of the call
      client - the client object the call is made on
      target - what the selector's main pattern matches: topic(s), method, command, AWS operation, or null
      detail - a second attribute: the AWS service, or null
      remoteAddress - the peer InetSocketAddress of a Netty channel, or null
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a scenario delays and then rejects the call

    • beforeRpcCall

      public void beforeRpcCall(Object client, @Nullable String method, boolean attempt) throws Throwable
      Called for a gRPC call on a channel whose retry policy repeats its attempts, in two parts. Once for the call, where it is made (newStream): its delay and gate, as without retries. Then for each attempt (RetriableStream.newSubstream): its reject only, so the policy sees a rejected attempt as a real UNAVAILABLE. A retried attempt starts on gRPC's own thread (the transport's, or its timer for a hedge), where a delay or gate would hold every call served there (ADR 0005).
      Parameters:
      client - the stream provider (the call) or the retrying stream (an attempt)
      method - the full method name, or null
      attempt - true for an attempt, false for the call
      Throws:
      Throwable - the gRPC status exception of a rejected attempt

    • beforeHttpSend

      public void beforeHttpSend(@Nullable String url, OperationType opType) throws Throwable
      Called before an HTTP client send. A reject throws the client's own IOException (ADR 0005: there is no suppress, which no real client does).
      Parameters:
      url - the target URL of the HTTP request
      opType - the specific OperationType for this send
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario rejects the send
